title: Board renderer
description: The client-side code that draws a folio's boards where the reader is: the avatar, window and layout machinery each content kind declares into. Mechanical — it runs a fixed program and exercises no judgement, which is why every decision in the board diagrams sits in the reader's lane. It is NOT the CI pipeline: that publishes and never reacts to a reader, and conflating the two would put a person's click behind a build.
